source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official client cloud GeoParquet and STAC bbox access contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The official Python client reads Overture cloud-hosted GeoParquet, resolves the latest release through STAC and targets data inside a supplied bbox rather than requiring a global download.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: STAC asset selection and Parquet row-group statistics contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Overture STAC exposes per-file spatial metadata, while GeoParquet row-group statistics allow query engines to skip irrelevant files and chunks for spatially bounded requests.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official PyArrow STAC index and filtered S3 dataset implementation.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The official client fetches catalog.json and collections.parquet, filters collection=building and intersecting bbox fields, selects AWS S3 assets, constructs an anonymous S3 dataset and applies the bbox expression during batch reads.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: PyArrow Dataset projection and predicate pushdown behavior.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: PyArrow Dataset supports column projection and predicate pushdown for Parquet datasets, enabling filtered scans of selected fields across local or cloud files.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Parquet row-group metadata and filtered read contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: PyArrow exposes Parquet row-group metadata and filtered reads; row-group statistics can eliminate nonmatching groups while requested columns restrict the projected data.
